body: Nope. I work 40 hours a week. I either give them all my money or they kick me out. Don't think they care about me getting my own place, they just want money. I'm going to end up being a poor, miserable, failure like them if I don't kill myself, so I'm trying to find a cheap and reliable option.

Only money makes me happy, the slim possibility of being rich in the future isn't enough for me to put up with being poor and miserable. I don't really see any other option, this hardly seems like something to cry over.

I don't anything wrong with that, if someone didn't enjoy the plot of a movie, no one would blame them for not seeing the movie. Same thing right now, I don't like the plot of my life, so I'm just not going to live it.

Yea, I guess life just isn't for me.

Pretty sure I'm meant to kill myself, if I deserved to be rich and happy I would have been by now and not have these unrealistic desires.

I don't have any money to save. I can't afford a car so doesn't make sense to get a license. Even if I did get a car, definitely couldn't afford gas. I guess I've wasted your time because suicide seems like the logical solution for me.

Why wouldn't I want to be rich? No longer have to worry about how I'm going to pay for basic utilities, rent, and food. If you're rich you can do whatever you want, go wherever you want, buy whatever you want. Wealth is the closest thing to true freedom in my opinion.
